response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), meanref AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS mean_avg_remaining FROM grp) SELECT g.zoneref AS site_code, g.insurstat AS insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_gb, g.avg_cpu_minus_gpu, g.avg_remaining_gb / m.mean_avg_remaining AS remaining_ratio FROM grp g CROSS JOIN meanref m WHERE m.mean_avg_remaining IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each processing row joins to at most one site through scanprocessing.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry, and processing rows with no matching site are excluded by the inner join.
Rows with a NULL sites.insurstat form their own group rather than being dropped.
The CPU-minus-GPU difference is computed per row, so a row is excluded from that average when either proccpu or procgpu is missing.
The ratio's denominator is the mean of the group averages across all groups, computed before the top-10 limit. A group with a NULL average remaining storage gets a NULL ratio.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude groups whose site insurance status is missing, so only sites with a recorded insurance status are ranked and counted in the mean.
